chunks: And it was said to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family: “O Messenger of Allah, so-and-so was afflicted with janabah while he had smallpox, so they washed him and he died.”
So he said: “They killed him! Why did they not ask? Why did they not perform tayammum for him? Surely, the cure for ignorance is asking.”

key_terms.الْعِيِّ: ignorance or inability arising from not knowing
key_terms.جَنَابَةٌ: a state of ritual impurity requiring ghusl
key_terms.مَجْدُورٌ: afflicted with smallpox or a severe skin illness
key_terms.يَمَّمُوهُ: they should have performed tayammum for him

ai.seo_question: What should be done if ghusl with water is harmful due to illness or injury?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that when using water would cause harm, tayammum is to be used instead of washing. It also condemns acting in religious matters without knowledge and emphasizes that asking qualified questions is the remedy for ignorance.
